tagline: The mother of all state dinners.

President Benson's State DinnerHot Shots! Part DeuxThe mother of all state dinners.Every recipe serves 4.
    First CourseSecond CourseThird CourseFourth Course
    First CourseThe President's wrong hors d'oeuvresPlan a reception, wrong hors d'oeuvres. Devils on horseback and cheese puffs.How to make it12 medjool dates, pitted60g blue cheese6 rashers of streaky bacon, halved125ml water50g butter75g plain flour2 eggs60g gruyere, grated1/2 tsp Dijon mustardStuff each date with a little blue cheese and wrap tightly in half a rasher.Boil the water and butter, tip in the flour and beat until it comes away from the pan.Cool slightly, beat in the eggs one at a time, then the gruyere and mustard.Pipe or spoon the dough into small balls on a lined tray.Bake the puffs and the dates at 200°C until the puffs are risen and golden and the bacon is crisp.Prime Minister Soto's prawn tempuraTug begs Japan not to make such good cars. Light tempura prawns, tentsuyu dipping sauce.How to make it16 green king prawns, peeled, tails on100g plain flour2 tbsp cornflour1 egg yolk200ml ice-cold soda water1 L vegetable oil, for frying125ml dashi stock3 tbsp soy sauce2 tbsp mirin1 5cm piece daikon, finely gratedWarm the dashi, soy and mirin together for the dipping sauce, then cool.Score the underside of each prawn so it stays straight.Stir the yolk and soda water, then flick in the flours and mix with chopsticks, leaving it lumpy.Dip the prawns and fry at 180°C in small batches until pale gold and crisp.Serve at once with the sauce and grated daikon.A plate of the President's cookiesCookie? He offers them round himself.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Second CourseTopper's bow-and-arrow roast chickenTopper fires a chicken from his bow. Lemon and garlic roast chicken, pan gravy.How to make it1.8kg whole chicken1 lemon, halved1 garlic bulb, halved4 thyme sprigs40g soft butter1kg small potatoes, halved2 tbsp olive oil1 tbsp plain flour375ml chicken stockRub the chicken with butter and salt and stuff it with the lemon, garlic and thyme.Toss the potatoes in oil and salt around the bird in a roasting tin.Roast at 200°C until the juices run clear and the potatoes are golden.Rest the chicken, then stir the flour into the pan juices and whisk in the stock to make gravy.Carve and serve with the potatoes and gravy.Topper and Ramada's spaghetti and meatballsTopper and Ramada share one strand. Beef and pork meatballs, slow tomato sauce.How to make it500g beef and pork mince50g fresh breadcrumbs60ml milk1 egg50g parmesan, grated, plus extra3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp olive oil2 x 400g tins of crushed tomatoes1/2 cup basil leaves400g spaghettiSoak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the mince, egg, parmesan, a third of the garlic and salt and roll into 20 balls.Brown the meatballs in the oil and set aside.Soften the remaining garlic in the pan, add the tomatoes and simmer, then return the meatballs and cook gently.Boil the spaghetti until al dente and toss with some sauce.Serve topped with meatballs, basil and parmesan.Third CourseFire extinguisher pistachio semifreddoBenson freezes Saddam with an extinguisher. Frozen honey and pistachio cream, rose syrup.How to make it4 eggs, separated100g caster sugar3 tbsp honey300ml thickened cream100g shelled pistachios, chopped2 tbsp rosewater50g sugar, for the syrup60ml waterWhisk the yolks with half the sugar and the honey until pale and thick.Whip the cream to soft peaks, and in a clean bowl whisk the whites with the remaining sugar to firm peaks.Fold the cream, then the whites and most of the pistachios, into the yolks and spoon into a lined loaf tin.Freeze overnight. Boil the sugar and water for the syrup, cool and stir in the rosewater.Slice, drizzle with rose syrup and scatter with the remaining pistachios.Fourth CourseTopper's Thai village iced teaTopper retires to a village in Thailand. Strong spiced black tea, condensed milk, ice.How to make it4 tbsp loose black tea2 star anises1 cinnamon stick1 L boiling water125ml sweetened condensed milk125ml evaporated milk3 cups ice cubesSteep the tea, star anise and cinnamon in the boiling water for 5 minutes, then strain.Stir in the condensed milk and chill.Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses and float the evaporated milk on top.French champagne for the toastEvery time the President gives an order, it gets screwed up.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
